title: Surf's Up Dolphin Cruises

services.name: Daytime Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: People ages 13 and up - $18 +tax Kids ages 12 and under - $15 +tax Babies ages 2 and under - free! 1 hour 30 minutes About Come join us for affordable family fun! You are guaranteed to see wild dolphins surf and play in their natural environment. We cruise in the calm waters of the Perdido Bay system. What to Bring Feel free to bring along a small cooler with drinks and 1.5 hour long Dolphin Cruise
